formal_statement: ∃ (x1 : ℕ), ∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : SimpleGraph (Fin x2)) [x4 : DecidableRel x3.Adj], (∀ (x5 : Fin x2), x3.degree x5 = (0 : ℕ) ∨ (3 : ℕ) ≤ x3.degree x5) → (∀ (x6 : Fin x2) (x7 : x3.Walk x6 x6), x7.IsCycle → (5 : ℕ) ≤ x7.length) → ∀ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x7 → (∀ (x9 : Fin x2 → Bool), x7.eval (List.ofFn x9) = Decidable.decide (∃ (x10 : Fin x2) (x11 : Fin x2), x3.Adj x10 x11 ∧ x9 x10 = Bool.true ∧ x9 x11 = Bool.true)) → ∃ (x10 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x10 ∧ x10.size + (1 : ℕ) ≤ x1 * (x7.size + (1 : ℕ)) ∧ ∀ (x11 x12 : Fin x2 → Bool), x10.eval (List.ofFn x11 ++ List.ofFn x12) = Decidable.decide (∃ (x13 : Fin x2) (x14 : Fin x2), x3.Adj x13 x14 ∧ x11 x13 = Bool.true ∧ x12 x14 = Bool.true)
plain_statement: There is a constant c such that for every graph with every degree 0 or at least 3 and no cycle shorter than 5: from a circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, with s gates for its edge function there is such a circuit with fewer than c(s+1) gates on two copies x, y of the inputs that is true exactly when x_u and y_v are on for some edge uv.
